thread:
alex: Quick flag: Coastline wants to drop CompetitorY and do a direct API swap. Main asks: response schema parity, per-request billing differences, and an enterprise security checklist. Can someone own the presales?
mira: I can. Ask them to share a sample payload set and their max sustained QPS. Also need their expected SLAs (p99 latency).
tom: I pulled their API docs. They send `messages[]` with role/system/user and expect `choices[]` back. Redwood's chat returns `outputs[]` with slightly different names. We'll need a lightweight shim or mapping layer.
sai: Security: they require customer-managed key support and retention controls. Also need SOC2 + pen test report. We already have both, but they want an HSM roadmap.
alex: Good. For pricing, they estimate ~30M tokens/mo initially. Can sales get a pilot price and committed-usage discount?
mira: Recommend pilot: 30% off for first 3 months, then move to committed Dedicated for predictable latency and cheaper per-token rate. I'll draft numbers.
tom: Prototype plan: I'll create a small express shim that accepts CompetitorY body and forwards to /v1/chat with mapping, dropping unsupported fields. Will include an opt-in to normalize tokens for accounting.
infra-bot: infra-bot: created workspace `coastline-poc`, invited `mira`, `tom`, `sai`, `alex`.
sai: Legal note: add a clause for data handling during POC (no production data until DPA signed). If they insist on full HSM, timeline is 6+ weeks; otherwise cloud-KMS with attestation is fine to start.
alex: OK next steps: Mira drafts pilot pricing and SOW; Tom posts shim PR and sample curl; Sai sends security checklist + DPA draft. Aim to have POC kickoff next Tue.
mira: Will do. Posting SOW spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow.
tom: Will open PR by EOD today with example mapping and curl snippets.
sai: Looping legal now. Will update thread with any blockers.
